problems.title: Keep a bell curve stable, then learn a moved target
problems.intent: After learning a simple bell curve, keep its centre, width and distribution correct while training continues; then track a shifted target and stay there.
problems.problem: BCAP and BISPF keep oscillating instead of settling. BISPF passes only 5 of 72 stationary checks, misses deadline re-acquisition and passes 0 of 24 shifted-hold checks. A one-time smoke pass does not establish stability.
problems.pass_summary: Yes, individual research configurations; no selected recipe passes the complete test.
passers: `kinetic-local-nsgda-cross-v1`, `kinetic-local-dualnorm-g-history-v1` and `kinetic-local-dualnorm-g-history-bank8-v-v1` pass, but fail ring16 and mode hold.

Cell-gradient-signal configurations and `cell-quota-minimum-change-forward-kl-g-v1` also pass. The latter passes mode hold too, but its later ring16 probe fails and it cannot run two-pole or word smoke.
A hand-built network can draw the target; that is a capacity witness, not a trained full-protocol PASS.
problems.next_step: Find an update rule that settles when correct but responds after a shift, then verify the same recipe on ring16 and mode hold. Existing trade-offs do not prove the problem impossible.

problems.title: Preserve rare clusters
problems.intent: Learn several blobs with different probabilities, including a rare 2% blob, without losing its population or collapsing its shape.
problems.problem: The rare blob receives little training signal. BISPF preserves its share but flattens its shape: minimum eigen ratio 0.004 against the required 0.15. BCAP also collapses it.
problems.pass_summary: Yes, transport and cell-moment research configurations; BCAP and BISPF fail.
passers: `kinetic_transport_local_v2` and the two kinetic g-history reference8 variants pass; they fail unequal-width and mode hold.
Round-5 direction blend plus local-v2 passes, but fails Gaussian stability and unequal-width and was not measured on most of the required suite.
Cell-moment aggregate recipes pass all four vector tests; they lose mode hold or ring16. True-target sampling passes 200/200 reference runs, which validates the gate but is not a training win.
problems.next_step: Preserve rare-cluster coverage and shape while checking unequal-width, ring16 and mode hold with one unchanged recipe.

problems.title: Learn narrow and broad clusters together
problems.intent: Give four equally likely blobs different widths while preserving both their shapes and their equal probabilities.
problems.problem: BISPF gets the shares wrong (mass TV 0.25) even where shapes pass. BCAP has both share and spread errors. A few strays can dominate a narrow blob.
problems.pass_summary: Yes, balanced assignment and cell-moment research configurations.
passers: Round-5 balanced coordinate assignment passes with 14 terminal checks and spread error 0.286, but loses unequal-mass, Gaussian stability and native 100-blob quality; much of the required suite is untried.
Cell-moment aggregate and per-kernel recipes pass but fail other required tests. G-angle has a historical-source pass, not a current selected pass.
problems.next_step: Test the balanced-assignment reference on the missing suite and solve its rare-cluster regression before claiming a global improvement.

problems.title: Learn stretched and tilted clusters
problems.intent: Match the populations and shapes of three equally likely blobs stretched horizontally, vertically and diagonally.
problems.problem: Both leading recipes allocate the wrong amounts to the blobs. BISPF has mass TV 0.191 against 0.15 and covariance error 2.0.
problems.pass_summary: Yes: K3P, KA2, R1/R2 in separate diagnostics, plus research configurations.
passers: K3P, KA2 and R1/R2 pass in the attempt index, separately from qualifying selected-cohort results. They fail mode hold, ring16 and the clock measurement in the recorded comparison.
Nine additional indexed research recipes and four cell-moment aggregates pass. Recorded passers with mode-hold measurements fail it.
problems.next_step: Retain the successful mass allocation while preserving mode hold and basic acquisition.

problems.title: Settle on an overlapping distribution
problems.intent: Match the observable centre, spread and distribution of two overlapping blobs; no hidden component labels are required.
problems.problem: BCAP reaches the target temporarily and drifts away. BISPF ends with centre error 0.28, covariance error 0.53 and distribution distance 0.19; it misses the sustained ending.
problems.pass_summary: Yes: K3P in separate diagnostics and multiple research recipes.
passers: K3P and ten other indexed configurations pass under the recorded declaration; all fail mode hold.
Four cell-moment aggregates pass; three lose mode hold and the Bures variant loses ring16.
problems.next_step: Add stability without losing multimodal acquisition or mode hold. A good endpoint alone does not meet the sustained gate.

problems.title: Generate all four bar images
problems.intent: Generate each of four simple bar pictures, rather than producing only a few convincing examples.
problems.problem: BCAP and BISPF produce clean pictures but only 2 of 4 bars. Some transport recipes reach more bars but produce too many blurry pictures.
problems.pass_summary: Yes: R1/R2 and GAN v3 in separate diagnostic measurements.
passers: R1/R2 and GAN v3 pass this declaration, but fail ring16, the clock measurement and the required stripes test.
Older historical recipes pass bars and stripes together under different contracts; they cannot fill today's cells.
problems.next_step: Preserve all four clean bar modes while passing stripes and the acquisition tests with the same recipe.

problems.title: Generate all four image corners
problems.intent: Generate a small bright square at each of four corners, with enough clean examples of every corner.
problems.problem: BISPF reaches 3 corners and 28/32 clean pictures; the gate requires all 4 and at least 29/32. BCAP reaches 2 corners. A near miss or four passing checks is not a five-check sustained pass.
problems.pass_summary: Yes: R1/R2 and kinetic research configurations.
passers: R1/R2 passes in separate diagnostic measurements with an 18-check streak, but loses ring16 and the clock measurement.
`kinetic_transport_local_v2` passes but fails two-pole and unused-token hold. Four kinetic history variants pass but are blocked on basic behavioural tests.
problems.next_step: Keep all four corners clean and sustained without breaking basic learning and identity preservation.

problems.title: Generate both brightness levels accurately
problems.intent: Generate a square at either of two target brightnesses, with both levels represented and little brightness error.
problems.problem: BISPF collapses to one brightness level. BCAP produces both but 10/32 pictures have inaccurate brightness.
problems.pass_summary: Yes: GAN v3, R1/R2 and kinetic transport in separate measurements.
passers: GAN v3, R1/R2 and `kinetic_transport_local_v2` pass the recorded declaration, but fail required Tier 1 tests.
A historical wider-network pass belongs to `img_intensity2_residual16`, a different task variant.
problems.next_step: Learn accurate, balanced brightness modes while retaining the other image and acquisition passes.

problems.title: A grid of 100 clusters
problems.intent: Learn all 100 small blobs with correct locations, populations and widths, scoring the current model's clean outputs without adding evaluation noise.
problems.problem: BCAP/BISPF put only 24–37% of samples on target, against 97% required. Some blobs are thin or nearly empty; the best audited 7,000-update result reaches 54%, still below the gate.
problems.pass_summary: No full PASS under the current clean-sampling declaration in the audited evidence.
passers: Historical K3P and other recipes have PASS receipts under earlier contracts, including different priors, averaged weights or evaluation noise. Those are separate problems and do not beat this declaration.
True-target samplers demonstrate feasibility. Longer BISPF training improves precision initially but plateaus below the gate.
problems.next_step: Improve both precise placement and within-cluster shape, then meet the sustained checks and independent holdout. Longer training alone has not solved it.

problems.title: Keep the 100-cluster grid correct for longer
problems.intent: Continue a model that passed the 7,000-update 100-cluster test to 14,000 updates without losing quality.
problems.problem: The required passing parent checkpoint does not exist. These are blocked continuations, not completed numerical failures. Continuing failed BISPF parents diagnostically still did not pass.
problems.pass_summary: No qualifying PASS; no passing current-declaration parent is available.
passers: The BISPF rescue continuations from failed parents remain below the precision gate and do not establish a valid endurance pass.
The rotated rescue has an INVALID cross-device coverage audit near a scoring boundary; it is not a PASS or a scientific FAIL.
problems.next_step: First obtain a genuine passing parent under the unchanged clean-sampling task, then continue that exact checkpoint. Keep rescue experiments separate.

problems.title: Recover quickly after the target moves
problems.intent: Learn and hold a ring of blobs, then track a sudden sideways shift within 400 updates and stay correct; a frozen model must fail to show the change is real.
problems.problem: BISPF learns and holds the original ring, then recovers too late: it becomes steady 620 updates after the shift, missing the 400-update deadline. This is an adaptation-speed failure, not an inability to recover at all.
problems.pass_summary: No complete PASS under the current declaration in the audited evidence.
passers: BISPF meets three of four parts but misses the recovery deadline.
Older PR215/PR217 recipes pass a different ring-shift question under earlier contracts, not this test.
problems.next_step: Improve adaptation speed while keeping stationary stability. If the deadline itself is reconsidered, use an explicitly versioned task and preserve the old failure.

problems.title: Keep every learned mode alive
problems.intent: Keep generating every target mode during continued training, rather than losing modes after initially finding them.
problems.problem: BCAP falls one sustained window short in the reviewed run (3 terminal passing checks; 5 required). This single test accounts for BISPF's six-point lead when repeated across six views.
problems.pass_summary: Yes: the selected BISPF recipe and some research configurations.
passers: `bispf-v1` has a recorded PASS with a 12-check terminal streak. Its source is stale; this is not a fresh current-source qualification.
The cell-quota minimum-change recipe also passes mode hold but fails ring16. The reviewed tether-only BCAP ablation does not reproduce the BISPF win.
problems.next_step: Preserve the BISPF pass on current source and combine it with repairs to Gaussian, vector and image failures.

problems.title: Keep a learned ring stable for a long run
problems.intent: Acquire all eight ring blobs, hold them for 1,200 consecutive checks, then survive 300 additional checks on the same uninterrupted run.
problems.problem: BISPF lacks an ordinary qualifying run in the selected cohort. BCAP's diagnostic run loses quality during the hold phase; the extension cannot rescue a failed hold.
problems.pass_summary: Yes: BISPF in a saved separate-runtime diagnostic; no selected ordinary PASS.
passers: BISPF producer `bf5d13ff` passes the full diagnostic run: 1,200/1,200 hold checks and 300/300 extension checks, with minimum quality above 0.99.
That diagnostic result is evidence the problem is solvable. It does not fill the selected cohort's unmeasured cell. `ring_hold` remains a visible phase, not a second independent test.
problems.next_step: Measure the unchanged BISPF recipe in its ordinary cohort on current source and preserve the whole acquisition/hold/extension protocol.

problems.title: Learn sixteen distinct clusters from scratch
problems.intent: Learn all sixteen blobs on a ring with balanced populations and real within-blob spread, rather than sixteen collapsed points.
problems.problem: The selected K3P, KA2, R1/R2 and GAN v3 measurements fail this Tier 1 gate, preventing later qualification. Their results on other questions do not erase this acquisition failure.
problems.pass_summary: Yes: selected BCAP and BISPF recipes.
passers: The selected BCAP DualNorm and `bispf-v1` records pass. Their recorded results remain bound to their original budgets and sources.
Some research recipes pass ring16 but lose mode hold; per-test winners do not establish a single winner for the entire suite.
problems.next_step: Retain the passing ring baseline while repairing the held tests. Longer-budget or changed-schedule results must remain explicitly separate until adopted and measured.

problems.title: Learning must not depend on external clock labels
problems.intent: Check that the same learning state and inputs produce the same update despite changed step labels, declared horizon, evaluation cadence or a save/restart.
problems.problem: The recorded scheduled K3P, KA2, R1/R2 and GAN v3 recipes depend on step or horizon through annealing. Good numerical fits do not satisfy this separate invariance requirement.
problems.pass_summary: Yes: selected BCAP and BISPF recipes.
passers: BCAP and BISPF pass the Tier 1 measurement with constant-rate configurations.
`clockfree_audit` is the duplicate longer-form gate and remains visible as a diagnostic; it is excluded from the distinct full-suite total to avoid counting the same question twice.
problems.next_step: Use saved internal state rather than external labels for adaptation, or explicitly version the desired policy. Do not silently treat an annealed recipe as clock-free.
